meta.name: trending-ad-hook-spotter
meta.description: Monitor Twitter/X, Reddit, LinkedIn, and Hacker News for trending narratives, viral posts, and hot-button topics in your space. Maps trends to ad hook opportunities with timing urgency scores. Tells you what to run ads about right now while the topic is hot.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 发现热点话题并生成广告创意时机
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要紧跟热点来策划广告投放。
copy.tagline_en: Spot trending topics and generate ad hook opportunities.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to ride trending topics for ad campaigns.

howto.what: 扫描 Twitter、Reddit、LinkedIn 和 Hacker News，找出你所在领域的热门话题，将其转化为广告创意，并给出紧迫性评分，告诉你现在该投放什么广告。
howto.when: 当你询问“我们空间里有什么热门话题可以投广告？”或“本周什么话题最火？”等类似问题时触发。

say.text: 我们行业最近有什么热门话题可以投广告？
say.note: 技能会扫描平台并生成广告创意。

say.text: 帮我找几个病毒式传播的广告钩子。
say.note: 技能会分析趋势并给出钩子变体。

say.text: 本周我们应该围绕什么话题投放广告？
say.note: 技能会生成本周可用的广告创意列表。

howto.what_en: Scans Twitter/X, Reddit, LinkedIn, and Hacker News for trending topics in your space, translates them into ad hooks with urgency scores, and tells you what ads to run right now.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about trending topics for ads, viral hooks, or what's hot in your space this week.

say_en.text: What's trending in our space that we could run ads about?
say_en.note: Skill scans platforms and generates ad hooks.

say_en.text: Find viral hooks for our paid campaigns.
say_en.note: Skill analyzes trends and provides hook variants.

say_en.text: What should we be running ads about this week?
say_en.note: Skill produces a list of actionable ad hooks for the week.
